notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Master Crafted Edition Update
notes.content:
Posted on behalf of SEGA and SneakyBox



Hi everyone,

We’ve got some important updates to share for Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine: Master Crafted Edition, including an extended refund policy, details on a 50% upgrade path discount, and a preview of the patch improvements coming soon.

💸 Refunds & Upgrade Discount – What You Need to Know

We’ve heard your concerns around pricing, and we want to be clear about the steps we’re taking to address them.

🟦 Extended Refund Window – Until July 10

If you’ve already purchased Space Marine: Master Crafted Edition, you are eligible for a full refund, regardless of playtime, as long as you request it before 6pm BST/10pm PST July 10 2025 (when the Steam Summer Sale ends).

🔗 Request Your Refund via Steam Support

🟨 50% Upgrade Discount

If you own Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition, you’re eligible for a 50% discount when buying the Master Crafted Edition from 6pm BST/10pm PST June 26 2025 until 6pm BST/10pm PST July 10 2025 when the discount offer ends. 

New buyers who already own the original game will see the discount automatically applied at checkout. 

If you already purchased the Master Crafted Edition and qualify for the discount, you’ll need to:   
[olist]
Request a refund manually via Steam Support (before July 10) 

Then re-purchase the game at the discounted price. 
[/olist]
We know this situation has been frustrating for some of you, and we’re sorry for the confusion it’s caused. We hope this approach offers a workable solution while we continue improving the game itself.

🔧 Patch Roadmap – Improvements Incoming

Thanks for all your feedback. We’re rolling out a series of patches over the coming weeks to improve the experience across the board:

🌍 Localisation

Updated Dutch, Polish, and Italian translations.

Improved localisation for game modes, controller options, and key terms (e.g. Skar Boyz).

🧭 UI/UX Enhancements

Major improvements to chat input, scoreboard layout, and HUD.

Better menu spacing, new glow effects, and tighter alignment.

Improved mission selection, unlock notifications, and subtitle persistence.

Added new button prompts, controller glyphs (including Steam Deck), and SFX.

Fixed various softlocks, input bugs, and graphical glitches.

⚔️ Gameplay Fixes

Fixed Exterminatus wave 5 softlock.

Restored co-op live tokens and fixed ammo display on the weapon wheel.

Enhanced challenge visuals, shield effects, and map loading.

🎮 Platform & Controller Support

Steam Deck now launches correctly (D3D12 guard page fix).

Improved handling for controller disconnects on PC.

🌐 Networking

Fixed session code visibility in streamer mode.

Improved EOS invites and session stability.

Disabled team auto-balancing during gameplay.

Enhanced P2P connection handling to reduce lobby splits.

🛠️ Technical & Build

Moved user profile data to AppData to reduce config-related crashes.

Added memory safety fixes and smoother fade animations.

🔊 Audio & Visual

Fixed missing/duplicate SFX.

Updated button textures and cleaned up visual effects.

We’ll continue listening, improving, and communicating as these changes go live. Thanks for sticking with us.

notes.title: Warhammer 40K: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition
notes.content:
The fan-favourite release Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine, originally developed by Relic Entertainment in 2011, has just turned 10 years old! To celebrate, we’ve put together the Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine - Anniversary Edition, collecting the original game with all its DLC, as well as a host of fun extras for fans. To celebrate 10 years of this seminal title, the Anniversary Edition will be a free upgrade for all existing owners of Space Marine on Steam!   

 {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/3952760/82a4b372f578e6552c239c4fe216d1813b786848.png

Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine puts players in the heart of the fight, showing what it truly means to be a Space Marine, and it’s still beloved by fans to this day. We’re excited to release this iconic game along with all its DLC, as well as some amazing extra content for players to enjoy. For the Emperor!    

The Anniversary Edition also include the original main Space Marine game, along with all DLC released for the game:  

 Chaos Unleashed Map Pack  
 Dreadnought Assault DLC  
 Iron Hand Veteran Chapter Pack DLC  
 Death Guard Champion Chapter Pack DLC  
 Golden Relic Bolter  
 Golden Relic Chainsword    
 Power Sword  
 Blood Angels Veteran Armour Set  
 Salamanders Veteran Armour Set  
 Alpha Legion Champion Armour Set  
 Legion of the Damned Armour Set  
 Emperor's Elite Pack  
 Traitor Legions Pack  

As well, this Anniversary Edition of the game includes for the first time:  


 The full soundtrack for the game  
 Classic and brand-new wallpapers  
 The original manual (pdf)  
 The Official Strategy Guide (pdf)  
 Ringtone  
 The Collector’s Edition Artbook (pdf)  
 Collector’s cards (pdfs)  
 The original launch trailer

notes.title: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine Update Released
notes.content:
Updates to Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine have been released. The updates will be applied automatically when your Steam client is restarted. The major changes include:

- Added mute all functionality and push to talk
- Fixed 'butterfly' exploit.
- Update matchmaking parameters to search for local matches longer.
- Fixed a crash when cancelling a search
- Fixed an issue where profile progress would not be saved properly if steam cloud was disabled.
- Fixed an exploit where the player can move at high speeds when switching weapons with the Weapons Versatility perk equipped during multiplayer.
